$comment: The toolchain the CI legs are pinned to, in one place. tools/ci/check_toolchain_versions.py fails when a workflow or an install script carries a different value (docs/ci.md). msvc_toolset is what windows-2025-vs2026 carries and has no other home. The vcpkg baseline stays in vcpkg.json. cmake is the newest version that lukka/get-cmake v4.3.4 has in its catalog, which is what its latest resolved to before the version was pinned. aqtsource is the aqtinstall commit the Windows leg installs Qt from: Qt 6.11 and later split the Windows repository per architecture, which the last PyPI release (3.3.0) cannot read; it is the commit the other repositories use. The NDK is the one Qt 6.12's Android kit is built with (r27c).
